verses.original: כִּי֩ הִנֵּ֨ה הָאָד֜וֹן יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת מֵסִ֤יר מִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ וּמִ֣יהוּדָ֔ה מַשְׁעֵ֖ן וּמַשְׁעֵנָ֑ה כֹּ֚ל מִשְׁעַן־ לֶ֔חֶם וְכֹ֖ל מִשְׁעַן־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nêh hā·’ā·ḏō·wn Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ mê·sîr mî·rū·šā·lim ū·mî·hū·ḏāh maš·‘ên ū·maš·‘ê·nāh kōl miš·‘an- le·ḥem wə·ḵōl miš·‘an- mā·yim
verses.literal: For behold the Lord GOD of Hosts is about to remove from Jerusalem and Judah both supply and support the whole supply of food . . . . . . and water
verses.literalPt: PORQUE, eis que o Senhor, o SENHOR dos Exércitos, tirará de Jerusalém e de Judá o sustento e o apoio; a todo o sustento de pão e a todo o sustento de água;

verses.original: גִּבּ֖וֹר וְאִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֑ה שׁוֹפֵ֥ט וְנָבִ֖יא וְקֹסֵ֥ם וְזָקֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: gib·bō·wr wə·’îš mil·ḥā·māh šō·w·p̄êṭ wə·nā·ḇî wə·qō·sêm wə·zā·qên
verses.literal: the mighty man and the warrior . . . the judge and the prophet the soothsayer and the elder
verses.literalPt: O poderoso, e o homem de guerra, o juiz, e o profeta, e o adivinho, e o ancião,

verses.original: שַׂר־ חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וּנְשׂ֣וּא פָנִ֑ים וְיוֹעֵ֛ץ וַחֲכַ֥ם חֲרָשִׁ֖ים וּנְב֥וֹן לָֽחַשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: śar- ḥă·miš·šîm ū·nə·śū p̄ā·nîm wə·yō·w·‘êṣ wa·ḥă·ḵam ḥă·rā·šîm ū·nə·ḇō·wn lā·ḥaš
verses.literal: the commander of fifty and the dignitary . . . the counselor the cunning magician and the clever enchanter
verses.literalPt: O capitão de cinqüenta, e o homem respeitável, e o conselheiro, e o sábio entre os artífices, e o eloqüente orador.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י נְעָרִ֖ים שָׂרֵיהֶ֑ם וְתַעֲלוּלִ֖ים יִמְשְׁלוּ־ בָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî nə·‘ā·rîm śā·rê·hem wə·ṯa·‘ă·lū·lîm yim·šə·lū- ḇām
verses.literal: I will make mere lads their leaders and children will rule over them
verses.literalPt: E dar-lhes-ei meninos por príncipes, e crianças governarão sobre eles.

verses.original: וְנִגַּ֣שׂ הָעָ֔ם אִ֥ישׁ בְּאִ֖ישׁ וְאִ֣ישׁ בְּרֵעֵ֑הוּ יִרְהֲב֗וּ הַנַּ֙עַר֙ בַּזָּקֵ֔ן וְהַנִּקְלֶ֖ה בַּנִּכְבָּֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nig·gaś hā·‘ām ’îš bə·’îš wə·’îš bə·rê·‘ê·hū yir·hă·ḇū han·na·‘ar baz·zā·qên wə·han·niq·leh ban·niḵ·bāḏ
verses.literal: The people will oppress one another man against man neighbor against neighbor the young will rise up against the old and the base against the honorable
verses.literalPt: E o povo será oprimido; um será contra o outro, e cada um contra o seu próximo; o menino se atreverá contra o ancião, e o vil contra o nobre.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יִתְפֹּ֨שׂ אִ֤ישׁ בְּאָחִיו֙ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔יו שִׂמְלָ֣ה לְכָ֔ה קָצִ֖ין תִּֽהְיֶה־ לָּ֑נוּ וְהַמַּכְשֵׁלָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את תַּ֥חַת יָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yiṯ·pōś ’îš bə·’ā·ḥîw bêṯ ’ā·ḇîw śim·lāh lə·ḵāh qā·ṣîn tih·yeh- lā·nū wə·ham·maḵ·šê·lāh haz·zōṯ ta·ḥaṯ yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: A man will seize his brother within his father’s house You have a cloak . . . you be our leader Take charge of this heap of rubble
verses.literalPt: Quando alguém pegar de seu irmão na casa de seu pai, dizendo: Tu tens roupa, sê nosso governador, e toma sob a tua mão esta ruína;

verses.original: יִשָּׂא֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֤וּא׀ לֵאמֹר֙ לֹא־ אֶהְיֶ֣ה חֹבֵ֔שׁ וּבְבֵיתִ֕י אֵ֥ין לֶ֖חֶם וְאֵ֣ין שִׂמְלָ֑ה לֹ֥א תְשִׂימֻ֖נִי קְצִ֥ין עָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·śā ḇay·yō·wm ha·hū lê·mōr lō- ’eh·yeh ḥō·ḇêš ū·ḇə·ḇê·ṯî ’ên le·ḥem wə·’ên śim·lāh lō ṯə·śî·mu·nî qə·ṣîn ‘ām
verses.literal: On that day he will cry aloud I am not a healer I have no food . . . or clothing in my house Do not make me leader of the people
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia levantará este a sua voz, dizendo: Não posso ser médico, nem tampouco há em minha casa pão, ou roupa alguma; não me haveis de constituir governador sobre o povo.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָשְׁלָה֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וִיהוּדָ֖ה נָפָ֑ל כִּֽי־ לְשׁוֹנָ֤ם וּמַֽעַלְלֵיהֶם֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה לַמְר֖וֹת עֵנֵ֥י כְבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵā·šə·lāh yə·rū·šā·lim wî·hū·ḏāh nā·p̄āl kî- lə·šō·w·nām ū·ma·‘al·lê·hem ’el- Yah·weh lam·rō·wṯ ‘ê·nê ḵə·ḇō·w·ḏōw
verses.literal: For Jerusalem has stumbled and Judah has fallen because they spoke and acted against the LORD defying His glorious presence
verses.literalPt: Porque Jerusalém está arruinada, e Judá caída; porque a sua língua e as suas obras são contra o SENHOR, para provocarem os olhos da sua glória.

verses.original: הַכָּרַ֤ת פְּנֵיהֶם֙ עָ֣נְתָה בָּ֔ם וְחַטָּאתָ֛ם כִּסְדֹ֥ם הִגִּ֖ידוּ לֹ֣א כִחֵ֑דוּ א֣וֹי לְנַפְשָׁ֔ם כִּֽי־ גָמְל֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם רָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kā·raṯ pə·nê·hem ‘ā·nə·ṯāh bām wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām kis·ḏōm hig·gî·ḏū lō ḵi·ḥê·ḏū ’ō·w lə·nap̄·šām kî- ḡā·mə·lū lā·hem rā·‘āh
verses.literal: The expression on their faces testifies against them and like Sodom they flaunt their sin they do not conceal it Woe to them for they have brought disaster upon themselves
verses.literalPt: O aspecto do seu rosto testifica contra eles; e publicam os seus pecados, como Sodoma; não os dissimulam. Ai da sua alma! Porque fazem mal a si mesmos.

verses.original: אִמְר֥וּ צַדִּ֖יק כִּי־ ט֑וֹב כִּֽי־ פְרִ֥י מַעַלְלֵיהֶ֖ם יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im·rū ṣad·dîq kî- ṭō·wḇ kî- p̄ə·rî ma·‘al·lê·hem yō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: Tell the righteous it will be well with them for they will enjoy the fruit of their labor
verses.literalPt: Dizei ao justo que bem lhe irá; porque comerão do fruto das suas obras.

verses.original: א֖וֹי לְרָשָׁ֣ע רָ֑ע כִּֽי־ גְמ֥וּל יָדָ֖יו יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w lə·rā·šā‘ rā‘ kî- ḡə·mūl yā·ḏāw yê·‘ā·śeh lōw
verses.literal: Woe to the wicked disaster is upon them For they will be repaid with what their hands have done
verses.literalPt: Ai do ímpio! Mal lhe irá; porque se lhe fará o que as suas mãos fizeram.

verses.original: עַמִּי֙ נֹגְשָׂ֣יו מְעוֹלֵ֔ל וְנָשִׁ֖ים מָ֣שְׁלוּ ב֑וֹ עַמִּי֙ מְאַשְּׁרֶ֣יךָ מַתְעִ֔ים וְדֶ֥רֶךְ אֹֽרְחֹתֶ֖יךָ בִּלֵּֽעוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mî nō·ḡə·śāw mə·‘ō·w·lêl wə·nā·šîm mā·šə·lū ḇōw ‘am·mî mə·’aš·šə·re·ḵā maṯ·‘îm wə·ḏe·reḵ ’ō·rə·ḥō·ṯe·ḵā bil·lê·‘ū
verses.literal: Youths oppress My people and women rule over them O My people your guides mislead you they turn you . . . from your paths
verses.literalPt: Os opressores do meu povo são crianças, e mulheres dominam sobre ele; ah, povo meu! Os que te guiam te enganam, e destroem o caminho das tuas veredas.

verses.original: נִצָּ֥ב לָרִ֖יב יְהוָ֑ה וְעֹמֵ֖ד לָדִ֥ין עַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: niṣ·ṣāḇ lā·rîḇ Yah·weh wə·‘ō·mêḏ lā·ḏîn ‘am·mîm
verses.literal: The LORD arises to contend He stands to judge the people
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR se levanta para pleitear, e põe-se de pé para julgar os povos.

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט יָב֔וֹא עִם־ זִקְנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹ וְשָׂרָ֑יו וְאַתֶּם֙ בִּֽעַרְתֶּ֣ם הַכֶּ֔רֶם גְּזֵלַ֥ת הֶֽעָנִ֖י בְּבָתֵּיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh bə·miš·pāṭ yā·ḇō·w ‘im- ziq·nê ‘am·mōw wə·śā·rāw wə·’at·tem bi·‘ar·tem hak·ke·rem gə·zê·laṯ he·‘ā·nî bə·ḇāt·tê·ḵem
verses.literal: The LORD brings this charge against the elders and leaders of His people You have devoured the vineyard the plunder of the poor is in your houses
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR entrará em juízo contra os anciãos do seu povo, e contra os seus príncipes; é que fostes vós que consumistes esta vinha; o espólio do pobre está em vossas casas.

verses.original: מַלָּכֶם תְּדַכְּא֣וּ עַמִּ֔י וּפְנֵ֥י עֲנִיִּ֖ים תִּטְחָ֑נוּ נְאֻם־ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: mal·lå̄·ḵɛm tə·ḏak·kə·’ū ‘am·mî ū·p̄ə·nê ‘ă·nî·yîm tiṭ·ḥā·nū nə·’um- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Why do you crush My people and grind the faces of the poor declares the Lord GOD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Que tendes vós, que esmagais o meu povo e moeis as faces dos pobres? Diz o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה יַ֚עַן כִּ֤י גָֽבְהוּ֙ בְּנ֣וֹת צִיּ֔וֹן וַתֵּלַ֙כְנָה֙ נְטוּוֹת גָּר֔וֹן וּֽמְשַׂקְּר֖וֹת עֵינָ֑יִם הָל֤וֹךְ וְטָפֹף֙ תֵּלַ֔כְנָה וּבְרַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם תְּעַכַּֽסְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ya·‘an kî ḡā·ḇə·hū bə·nō·wṯ ṣî·yō·wn wat·tê·laḵ·nāh nə·ṭūōṯ gā·rō·wn ū·mə·śaq·qə·rō·wṯ ‘ê·nā·yim hā·lō·wḵ wə·ṭā·p̄ōp̄ tê·laḵ·nāh ū·ḇə·raḡ·lê·hem tə·‘ak·kas·nāh
verses.literal: The LORD also says Because . . . the daughters of Zion are haughty walking with heads held high and wanton eyes prancing and skipping as they go jingling the bracelets on their ankles
verses.literalPt: Diz ainda mais o SENHOR: Porquanto as filhas de Sião se exaltam, e andam com o pescoço erguido, lançando olhares impudentes; e quando andam, caminham afetadamente, fazendo um tilintar com os seus pés;

verses.original: וְשִׂפַּ֣ח אֲדֹנָ֔י קָדְקֹ֖ד בְּנ֣וֹת צִיּ֑וֹן וַיהוָ֖ה פָּתְהֵ֥ן יְעָרֶֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·śip·paḥ ’ă·ḏō·nāy qā·ḏə·qōḏ bə·nō·wṯ ṣî·yō·wn Yah·weh pā·ṯə·hên yə·‘ā·reh
verses.literal: the Lord will bring sores on the heads of the daughters of Zion and the LORD will make their foreheads bare
verses.literalPt: Portanto o Senhor fará tinhoso o alto da cabeça das filhas de Sião, e o SENHOR porá a descoberto a sua nudez,

verses.original: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא יָסִ֣יר אֲדֹנָ֗י אֵ֣ת תִּפְאֶ֧רֶת הָעֲכָסִ֛ים וְהַשְּׁבִיסִ֖ים וְהַשַּׂהֲרֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū yā·sîr ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’êṯ tip̄·’e·reṯ hā·‘ă·ḵā·sîm wə·haš·šə·ḇî·sîm wə·haś·śa·hă·rō·nîm
verses.literal: In that day the Lord will take away their finery their anklets and headbands and crescents
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia tirará o Senhor os ornamentos dos pés, e as toucas, e adornos em forma de lua,

verses.original: הַנְּטִיפ֥וֹת וְהַשֵּׁיר֖וֹת וְהָֽרְעָלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: han·nə·ṭî·p̄ō·wṯ wə·haš·šê·rō·wṯ wə·hā·rə·‘ā·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: their pendants bracelets and veils
verses.literalPt: Os pendentes, e os braceletes, as estolas,

verses.original: הַפְּאֵרִ֤ים וְהַצְּעָדוֹת֙ וְהַקִּשֻּׁרִ֔ים וּבָתֵּ֥י הַנֶּ֖פֶשׁ וְהַלְּחָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: hap·pə·’ê·rîm wə·haṣ·ṣə·‘ā·ḏō·wṯ wə·haq·qiš·šu·rîm ū·ḇāt·tê han·ne·p̄eš wə·hal·lə·ḥā·šîm
verses.literal: their headdresses ankle chains and sashes their perfume bottles and charms
verses.literalPt: Os gorros, e os ornamentos das pernas, e os cintos e as caixinhas de perfumes, e os brincos,

verses.original: הַטַּבָּע֖וֹת וְנִזְמֵ֥י הָאָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: haṭ·ṭab·bā·‘ō·wṯ wə·niz·mê hā·’āp̄
verses.literal: their signet rings and nose rings
verses.literalPt: Os anéis, e as jóias do nariz,

verses.original: הַמַּֽחֲלָצוֹת֙ וְהַמַּ֣עֲטָפ֔וֹת וְהַמִּטְפָּח֖וֹת וְהָחֲרִיטִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ham·ma·ḥă·lā·ṣō·wṯ wə·ham·ma·‘ă·ṭā·p̄ō·wṯ wə·ham·miṭ·pā·ḥō·wṯ wə·hā·ḥă·rî·ṭîm
verses.literal: their festive robes capes cloaks and purses
verses.literalPt: Os vestidos de festa, e os mantos, e os xales, e as bolsas.

verses.original: וְהַגִּלְיֹנִים֙ וְהַסְּדִינִ֔ים וְהַצְּנִיפ֖וֹת וְהָרְדִידִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hag·gil·yō·nîm wə·has·sə·ḏî·nîm wə·haṣ·ṣə·nî·p̄ō·wṯ wə·hā·rə·ḏî·ḏîm
verses.literal: and their mirrors linen garments tiaras and shawls
verses.literalPt: Os espelhos, e o linho finíssimo, e os turbantes, e os véus.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ תַ֨חַת בֹּ֜שֶׂם מַ֣ק יִֽהְיֶ֗ה וְתַ֨חַת חֲגוֹרָ֤ה נִקְפָּה֙ וְתַ֨חַת מַעֲשֶׂ֤ה מִקְשֶׁה֙ קָרְחָ֔ה וְתַ֥חַת פְּתִיגִ֖יל מַחֲגֹ֣רֶת שָׂ֑ק כִּי־ תַ֖חַת יֹֽפִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ṯa·ḥaṯ bō·śem maq yih·yeh wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ ḥă·ḡō·w·rāh niq·pāh wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ ma·‘ă·śeh miq·šeh qā·rə·ḥāh wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ pə·ṯî·ḡîl ma·ḥă·ḡō·reṯ śāq kî- ṯa·ḥaṯ yō·p̄î
verses.literal: Instead of fragrance there will be a stench . . . instead of a belt a rope instead of styled hair baldness instead of fine clothing sackcloth . . . instead of beauty shame
verses.literalPt: E será que em lugar de perfume haverá mau cheiro; e por cinto uma corda; e em lugar de encrespadura de cabelos, calvície; e em lugar de veste luxuosa, pano de saco; e queimadura em lugar de formosura.

verses.original: מְתַ֖יִךְ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֑לוּ וּגְבוּרָתֵ֖ךְ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mə·ṯa·yiḵ ba·ḥe·reḇ yip·pō·lū ū·ḡə·ḇū·rā·ṯêḵ bam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Your men will fall by the sword and your warriors in battle
verses.literalPt: Teus homens cairão à espada e teus poderosos na peleja.

verses.original: וְאָנ֥וּ וְאָבְל֖וּ פְּתָחֶ֑יהָ וְנִקָּ֖תָה לָאָ֥רֶץ תֵּשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nū wə·’ā·ḇə·lū pə·ṯā·ḥe·hā wə·niq·qā·ṯāh lā·’ā·reṣ tê·šêḇ
verses.literal: And the gates of Zion will lament and mourn destitute she will sit on the ground
verses.literalPt: E as suas portas gemerão e prantearão; e ela, desolada, se assentará no chão.
